```{r}
#Libraries and project directory

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(CARBayes)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)

folder <- "C:/Users/ranve/Documents/Bioinformatics/Individual project"


#Helper functions

clean <- function(x) str_squish(as.character(x))
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", clean(x))))

correct_LAD_codes <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x == "E08000038"] <- "E08000016"
  x[x == "E08000039"] <- "E08000019"
  x
}


#Retrieve Fingertips indicators

get_indicator <- function(id, variable) {
  fingertipsR::fingertips_data(IndicatorID = id, AreaTypeID = 501) %>%
    filter(Timeperiod == "2024/25", AreaType == "Districts & UAs (from Apr 2023)") %>%
    transmute(LAD24CD = correct_LAD_codes(AreaCode), "{variable}" := num(Value)) %>%
    distinct(LAD24CD, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

smoking_clean <- get_indicator(93085, "smoking_at_delivery")
age_clean <- get_indicator(92250, "maternal_age_35plus")

obesity_data <- tryCatch(
  fingertipsR::fingertips_data(IndicatorID = 93881, AreaTypeID = 501),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

obesity_clean <- if (is.null(obesity_data)) {
  tibble(LAD24CD = character(), obesity = numeric())
} else {
  obesity_data %>%
    filter(Timeperiod == "2024/25", AreaType == "Districts & UAs (from Apr 2023)") %>%
    transmute(LAD24CD = correct_LAD_codes(AreaCode), obesity = num(Value)) %>%
    distinct(LAD24CD, .keep_all = TRUE)
}


#Combine existing and supplemental LAD data

full_extension <- england_data %>%
  select(LAD24CD, LAD24NM, births, stillbirths, IMD_rank,
         ethnic_minority_pct = ethnic_minority_pct.x) %>%
  mutate(LAD24CD = correct_LAD_codes(LAD24CD)) %>%
  left_join(smoking_clean, by = "LAD24CD") %>%
  left_join(age_clean, by = "LAD24CD") %>%
  left_join(obesity_clean, by = "LAD24CD") %>%
  filter(str_detect(LAD24CD, "^E"))

requested_LADs <- read_excel(file.path(folder, "requested_LADs_all_data.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(
    LAD24CD = correct_LAD_codes(LAD24CD),
    LAD24NM = clean(LAD24NM),
    LAD24CD = if_else(
      str_detect(LAD24CD, "E06000052.*E06000053|E06000053.*E06000052"),
      "E06000052_E06000053",
      LAD24CD
    ),
    maternal_age_35plus = if_else(live_births > 0, 100 * maternal_age_35plus_count / live_births, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    LAD24CD, LAD24NM,
    births = live_births,
    stillbirths,
    IMD_rank = mean_lsoa_imd_rank,
    ethnic_minority_pct,
    smoking_at_delivery = smoking_at_delivery_value,
    maternal_age_35plus,
    obesity = obesity_value
  )

full_extension <- full_extension %>%
  filter(!LAD24CD %in% requested_LADs$LAD24CD) %>%
  bind_rows(requested_LADs) %>%
  arrange(LAD24CD)


#Create complete-case modelling dataset

full_extension_complete <- full_extension %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(births), births > 0,
    !is.na(stillbirths),
    !is.na(IMD_rank),
    !is.na(ethnic_minority_pct),
    !is.na(smoking_at_delivery),
    !is.na(maternal_age_35plus),
    !is.na(obesity)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    observed_rate_per_1000 = stillbirths / births * 1000,
    IMD_scaled = as.numeric(scale(IMD_rank)),
    ethnicity_scaled = as.numeric(scale(ethnic_minority_pct)),
    smoking_scaled = as.numeric(scale(smoking_at_delivery)),
    age_scaled = as.numeric(scale(maternal_age_35plus)),
    obesity_scaled = as.numeric(scale(obesity))
  )

if (nrow(full_extension_complete) < 2) {
  stop("Insufficient complete LAD data to fit the model.")
}

full_model_data <- as.data.frame(full_extension_complete)


#Download and prepare English LAD boundaries

url <- paste0(
  "https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/",
  "Local_Authority_Districts_May_2024_Boundaries_UK_BGC/",
  "FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&f=geojson"
)

lad_uk <- st_read(url, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(LAD24CD = correct_LAD_codes(LAD24CD))

england_sf_base <- lad_uk %>%
  filter(str_detect(LAD24CD, "^E")) %>%
  st_make_valid()


#Combine Cornwall and Isles of Scilly

cornwall_scilly_sf <- england_sf_base %>%
  filter(LAD24CD %in% c("E06000052", "E06000053")) %>%
  summarise(LAD24CD = "E06000052_E06000053", LAD24NM = "Cornwall and Isles of Scilly", do_union = TRUE)

england_sf_model <- england_sf_base %>%
  filter(!LAD24CD %in% c("E06000052", "E06000053")) %>%
  bind_rows(cornwall_scilly_sf) %>%
  arrange(LAD24CD)

full_sf <- england_sf_model %>%
  filter(LAD24CD %in% full_model_data$LAD24CD) %>%
  arrange(match(LAD24CD, full_model_data$LAD24CD))


#Create Queen-contiguity adjacency matrix

full_sf <- st_make_valid(full_sf)
full_nb <- poly2nb(full_sf, queen = TRUE)
full_W <- nb2mat(full_nb, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)

isolated <- which(rowSums(full_W) == 0)

if (length(isolated) > 0) {
  full_sf_27700 <- st_transform(full_sf, 27700)
  representative_points <- st_point_on_surface(full_sf_27700)
  coordinates <- st_coordinates(representative_points)
  distance_matrix <- as.matrix(dist(coordinates))

  for (i in isolated) {
    distance_matrix[i, i] <- Inf
    nearest_idx <- which.min(distance_matrix[i, ])
    full_W[i, nearest_idx] <- 1
    full_W[nearest_idx, i] <- 1
  }
}

rownames(full_W) <- colnames(full_W) <- full_sf$LAD24CD


#Fit the Bayesian spatial model

final_model <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = stillbirths ~ IMD_scaled + ethnicity_scaled + smoking_scaled + age_scaled + obesity_scaled + offset(log(births)),
  family = "poisson",
  data = full_model_data,
  W = full_W,
  burnin = 10000,
  n.sample = 50000,
  thin = 1,
  n.chains = 1,
  n.cores = 1,
  verbose = TRUE
)


#Summarise posterior coefficients

beta_samples <- final_model$samples$beta

beta_names <- c("Intercept", "IMD_scaled", "ethnicity_scaled", "smoking_scaled", "age_scaled", "obesity_scaled")
colnames(beta_samples) <- beta_names

beta_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable = beta_names,
  Posterior_Mean = apply(beta_samples, 2, mean),
  Lower_95_CrI = apply(beta_samples, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025),
  Upper_95_CrI = apply(beta_samples, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Rate_Ratio = exp(Posterior_Mean),
    RR_Lower_95_CrI = exp(Lower_95_CrI),
    RR_Upper_95_CrI = exp(Upper_95_CrI)
  )


#Calculate posterior LAD-specific rates

phi_samples <- final_model$samples$phi

X <- model.matrix(~ IMD_scaled + ethnicity_scaled + smoking_scaled + age_scaled + obesity_scaled, data = full_model_data)

n_post <- nrow(beta_samples)
n_lad <- nrow(full_model_data)

posterior_rate <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_post, ncol = n_lad)

if (nrow(phi_samples) != n_post || ncol(phi_samples) != n_lad) {
  stop("Posterior spatial effects do not match the model data.")
}

for (s in seq_len(n_post)) {
  eta <- as.numeric(X %*% beta_samples[s, ]) + phi_samples[s, ]
  posterior_rate[s, ] <- exp(eta) * 1000
}


#Calculate hotspot probabilities

threshold_rate <- 3.9

hotspot_results <- data.frame(
  LAD24CD = full_model_data$LAD24CD,
  LAD24NM = full_model_data$LAD24NM,
  births = full_model_data$births,
  stillbirths = full_model_data$stillbirths,
  observed_rate_per_1000 = full_model_data$observed_rate_per_1000,
  posterior_mean_rate = colMeans(posterior_rate),
  posterior_median_rate = apply(posterior_rate, 2, median),
  posterior_lower_95 = apply(posterior_rate, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025),
  posterior_upper_95 = apply(posterior_rate, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975),
  probability_rate_above_3_9 = colMeans(posterior_rate > threshold_rate)
) %>%
  mutate(
    hotspot_probability_category = case_when(
      probability_rate_above_3_9 >= 0.95 ~ "Very high probability",
      probability_rate_above_3_9 >= 0.80 ~ "High probability",
      probability_rate_above_3_9 >= 0.50 ~ "Moderate probability",
      probability_rate_above_3_9 >= 0.20 ~ "Low probability",
      TRUE ~ "Very low probability"
    ),
    hotspot_95 = probability_rate_above_3_9 >= 0.95
  )

top_hotspots <- hotspot_results %>%
  arrange(desc(probability_rate_above_3_9))

high_probability_hotspots <- hotspot_results %>%
  filter(hotspot_95) %>%
  arrange(desc(probability_rate_above_3_9))


#Prepare UK map data

lad_uk_map <- lad_uk %>%
  filter(!LAD24CD %in% c("E06000052", "E06000053")) %>%
  bind_rows(cornwall_scilly_sf)

posterior_map_data <- lad_uk_map %>%
  left_join(
    hotspot_results %>%
      select(LAD24CD, probability_rate_above_3_9, posterior_mean_rate, posterior_median_rate, posterior_lower_95, posterior_upper_95),
    by = "LAD24CD"
  )


#Plot posterior hotspot probabilities

posterior_hotspot_plot <- ggplot(posterior_map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = probability_rate_above_3_9), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma", limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95, 1),
    labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "95%", "100%"),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Posterior probability\nrate > 3.9 per 1,000"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Posterior Probability of Stillbirth Rate Exceeding 3.9 per 1,000") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.6, "cm")
  )

ggsave(file.path(folder, "FINAL_posterior_hotspot_probability_map_full_model.png"), plot = posterior_hotspot_plot, width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300)
print(posterior_hotspot_plot)


#Plot binary 95% hotspot classification

hotspot_map_data <- lad_uk_map %>%
  left_join(hotspot_results %>% select(LAD24CD, hotspot_95), by = "LAD24CD")

binary_hotspot_map <- ggplot(hotspot_map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = hotspot_95), colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "grey90", "TRUE" = "red"),
    na.value = "grey90",
    labels = c("FALSE" = "P(rate > 3.9) < 0.95", "TRUE" = "P(rate > 3.9) >= 0.95"),
    name = "Hotspot"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Posterior Probability Hotspots for Stillbirth Risk") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(1.2, "cm")
  )

ggsave(file.path(folder, "FINAL_binary_hotspot_map_full_model_95percent.png"), plot = binary_hotspot_map, width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300)
print(binary_hotspot_map)


#Export final results

write_xlsx(
  list(
    hotspot_results = hotspot_results,
    coefficient_results = beta_summary,
    top_hotspots = top_hotspots,
    high_probability_hotspots = high_probability_hotspots,
    complete_model_data = full_extension_complete
  ),
  file.path(folder, "FINAL_full_model_hotspot_results.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
#Libraries

library(CARBayes)
library(spdep)
library(sf)
library(writexl)


#Check data and spatial order

n <- nrow(full_model_data)

stopifnot(nrow(full_sf) == n, identical(full_sf$LAD24CD, full_model_data$LAD24CD))

observed <- full_model_data$stillbirths
predicted <- numeric(n)


#Create spatial weights matrix

nb_full_loocv <- poly2nb(full_sf, queen = TRUE)
W_full_loocv <- nb2mat(nb_full_loocv, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)

zero_idx <- which(rowSums(W_full_loocv) == 0)

if (length(zero_idx) > 0) {
  full_points <- st_point_on_surface(st_transform(full_sf, 27700))
  distance_matrix <- as.matrix(dist(st_coordinates(full_points)))

  for (j in zero_idx) {
    distance_matrix[j, j] <- Inf
    nearest <- which.min(distance_matrix[j, ])
    W_full_loocv[j, nearest] <- 1
    W_full_loocv[nearest, j] <- 1
  }
}

W_full_loocv <- ifelse((W_full_loocv + t(W_full_loocv)) > 0, 1, 0)
diag(W_full_loocv) <- 0

stopifnot(isSymmetric(W_full_loocv), all(rowSums(W_full_loocv) > 0))


#Run leave-one-out cross-validation

set.seed(123)

predictors <- c("IMD_rank", "ethnic_minority_pct", "smoking_at_delivery", "maternal_age_35plus", "obesity")
scaled_names <- c("IMD_scaled", "ethnicity_scaled", "smoking_scaled", "age_scaled", "obesity_scaled")

for (i in 1:n) {

  train_data <- full_model_data[-i, ]
  train_sf <- full_sf[-i, ]
  test_data <- full_model_data[i, ]

  #Standardise predictors using training data

  for (j in seq_along(predictors)) {
    variable <- predictors[j]
    scaled_variable <- scaled_names[j]

    training_mean <- mean(train_data[[variable]])
    training_sd <- sd(train_data[[variable]])

    if (!is.finite(training_sd) || training_sd == 0) {
      stop(paste("Invalid standard deviation for", variable, "in fold", i))
    }

    train_data[[scaled_variable]] <- (train_data[[variable]] - training_mean) / training_sd
    test_data[[scaled_variable]] <- (test_data[[variable]] - training_mean) / training_sd
  }


  #Create training spatial weights

  W_train <- W_full_loocv[-i, -i, drop = FALSE]
  zero_train_idx <- which(rowSums(W_train) == 0)

  if (length(zero_train_idx) > 0) {
    train_points <- st_point_on_surface(st_transform(train_sf, 27700))
    train_distances <- as.matrix(dist(st_coordinates(train_points)))

    for (j in zero_train_idx) {
      train_distances[j, j] <- Inf
      nearest <- which.min(train_distances[j, ])
      W_train[j, nearest] <- 1
      W_train[nearest, j] <- 1
    }
  }

  W_train <- ifelse((W_train + t(W_train)) > 0, 1, 0)
  diag(W_train) <- 0

  stopifnot(isSymmetric(W_train), all(rowSums(W_train) > 0), nrow(W_train) == nrow(train_data))


  #Fit the five-predictor CAR Leroux model

  model <- S.CARleroux(
    formula = stillbirths ~ IMD_scaled + ethnicity_scaled + smoking_scaled + age_scaled + obesity_scaled + offset(log(births)),
    family = "poisson",
    data = train_data,
    W = W_train,
    burnin = 10000,
    n.sample = 50000,
    thin = 1,
    n.chains = 1,
    n.cores = 1,
    verbose = FALSE
  )


  #Extract posterior samples

  beta_draws <- model$samples$beta
  phi_draws <- model$samples$phi
  rho_draws <- as.numeric(model$samples$rho)
  tau2_draws <- as.numeric(model$samples$tau2)

  if (ncol(beta_draws) != 6 || ncol(phi_draws) != nrow(train_data) || nrow(beta_draws) != nrow(phi_draws) || length(rho_draws) != nrow(beta_draws) || length(tau2_draws) != nrow(beta_draws)) {
    stop(paste("Posterior sample dimensions do not match in fold", i))
  }


  #Calculate fixed-effect prediction

  x_test <- c(1, test_data$IMD_scaled, test_data$ethnicity_scaled, test_data$smoking_scaled, test_data$age_scaled, test_data$obesity_scaled)
  eta_fixed <- as.numeric(beta_draws %*% x_test) + log(test_data$births)


  #Predict held-out spatial effect

  w_heldout <- W_full_loocv[i, -i]

  if (sum(w_heldout) == 0) {
    full_points <- st_point_on_surface(st_transform(full_sf, 27700))
    heldout_coordinates <- st_coordinates(full_points[i, ])
    training_coordinates <- st_coordinates(full_points[-i, ])

    distances <- sqrt(rowSums((training_coordinates - matrix(heldout_coordinates, nrow = nrow(training_coordinates), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE))^2))
    nearest <- which.min(distances)
    w_heldout[nearest] <- 1
  }

  heldout_degree <- sum(w_heldout)
  spatial_mean <- numeric(nrow(phi_draws))
  spatial_variance <- numeric(nrow(phi_draws))

  for (s in 1:nrow(phi_draws)) {
    denominator <- 1 - rho_draws[s] + rho_draws[s] * heldout_degree
    spatial_mean[s] <- rho_draws[s] * sum(w_heldout * phi_draws[s, ]) / denominator
    spatial_variance[s] <- tau2_draws[s] / denominator
  }


  #Calculate predicted stillbirth count

  predicted_draws <- exp(eta_fixed + spatial_mean + 0.5 * spatial_variance)
  predicted[i] <- mean(predicted_draws)

}


#Calculate cross-validation performance

rmse <- sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2))
mae <- mean(abs(observed - predicted))
bias <- mean(predicted - observed)


#Prepare results

results <- data.frame(
  LAD = full_model_data$LAD24CD,
  LAD_name = full_model_data$LAD24NM,
  observed = observed,
  predicted = predicted,
  error = predicted - observed
)


#Export results

write_xlsx(
  list(
    predictions = results,
    validation = data.frame(RMSE = rmse, MAE = mae, Bias = bias)
  ),
  file.path(folder, "LOOCV_full_model.xlsx")
)
```
